# Research — Tomáš Guth Jarkovský

_Date: 2026-06-17 · LinkedIn blocked (HTTP 999); built from public web sources._

## Who he is (2–3 sentences)
Czech human-rights advocate, technologist, and civic figure. Works as an advocacy specialist
at **Amnesty International** (Czech branch) and as a **software project manager / game
designer**; active in the **Czech Pirate Party** (deputy head of the foreign-affairs
department, coordinates Young Pirates) and a former parliamentary advisor. Self-describes as
human-rights worker, activist, math/physics graduate, **photographer**, and **AI instructor**.

## Profile
- **Education:** Informatics, Faculty of Mathematics & Physics, Charles University (MFF UK);
  Biskupské gymnázium, České Budějovice.
- **Base:** České Budějovice / South Bohemia + Prague (Amnesty / party work).
- **Hats:** advocacy & human rights · tech/PM & game design · politics · AI education · photography.

## Focus areas
Human rights, gender equality, **digital rights**, foreign human-rights policy, migration,
China-related issues, combating sexualized violence, humanitarian response to war.

## Audience (who the photos must convince)
- NGO / policy / human-rights community (credibility, gravitas, trust)
- Czech public & party supporters (approachable, principled, modern)
- International human-rights networks (professional, English-facing)
- Tech / AI training audiences (competent, contemporary, clear communicator)

## Brand voice
Principled, substantive, civic-minded, modern-progressive. Earnest but not stiff; values
authenticity and competence over polish-for-polish's-sake.

## Current visual identity
- No personal website provided. Present on Instagram (`@tgjarkovsky`), X (`@TGuthJarkovsky`).
- **Note:** he is himself a photographer + AI instructor → a visually literate, discerning
  subject. Concepts should be craft-forward and concept-driven, not generic corporate.
- Pirate Party visual language skews modern, clean, **black + party-color accents**; Amnesty
  skews humanist photojournalism (candid, real, human-centered, often b&w or desaturated).

## Competitive / category visual landscape
- **Advocacy / NGO leaders:** candid, environmental, human-centered, documentary feel;
  authenticity over gloss.
- **Political figures (CZ/EU):** clean studio or civic-location portraits, confident eye
  contact, restrained palette, flag/architecture context.
- **Tech / AI educators:** contemporary, well-lit, approachable, often desk/stage/teaching context.
- **Gap to exploit:** few people sit at the intersection of *human-rights gravitas* + *tech
  credibility*. A look that fuses humanist warmth with modern technologist clarity is distinctive.

## Opportunities
- He spans advocacy, tech, and politics — give him a **modular set** usable across Amnesty,
  party, speaking, and AI-teaching contexts rather than one narrow look.
- Lean into authenticity (his audiences distrust over-polish) while keeping it sharp.

## Visual keywords
**humanist · principled · modern-civic · candid-but-considered · clear/competent**
Palette leanings: restrained neutrals + a single confident accent; documentary b&w option.

## Sources
- https://www.instagram.com/tgjarkovsky/ (self-description)
- https://cz.linkedin.com/in/tgjarkovsky/cs (role: PM / game designer — title only, body blocked)
- https://lide.pirati.cz/profil/3684/ , https://lide.pirati.cz/profil/2876/ (party affiliation)

concepts.title: Humanist Advocate
concepts.pitch: Documentary-style portraits that read as principled, warm, and real — Amnesty / NGO register.
concepts.why: advocacy specialist at Amnesty + writes on war/human rights; his audiences distrust gloss and reward authenticity (research: brand voice, NGO visual norms).
concepts.mood: humanist, candid, warm, quietly serious — 4 adjectives.
concepts.wardrobe: simple, textured, lived-in — knit, open collar, no flashy logos; earth tones.
concepts.location: real environments — desk with papers, bookshelf, window light, street/urban exterior. Backup: home/office near window.
concepts.lighting: natural / available light, soft directional from window; documentary, not staged.
shotList: tight candid headshot, eyes to camera
concepts.poseDirection: relaxed, unguarded; weight settled; genuine micro-expressions over posed smiles; hands engaged.

concepts.title: Modern Civic
concepts.pitch: Clean, confident portraits with architectural restraint — political / speaking / LinkedIn register.
concepts.why: Pirate Party deputy (foreign affairs), civic/public figure; political visual norms = clean, confident, restrained palette (research: competitive landscape).
concepts.wardrobe: sharp but unfussy — dark jacket, fine knit or crisp shirt, no tie; minimal.
concepts.location: studio seamless (mid-grey) OR modern civic architecture — concrete, glass, strong lines, negative space.
concepts.lighting: soft clean key + subtle rim; even, controlled; slight contrast for authority.
concepts.poseDirection: upright, grounded stance; shoulders open; calm direct eye contact; controlled, deliberate.

concepts.title: Technologist / AI Educator
concepts.pitch: Contemporary, dynamic, in-context frames — tech credibility & AI-instructor register.
concepts.why: software PM / game designer + self-described AI instructor + MFF UK informatics; tech-educator visual norms = contemporary, teaching/stage context (research: hats, gap to exploit).
concepts.mood: sharp, modern, engaged, forward — energetic vs. A/B.
concepts.wardrobe: smart-casual contemporary — clean shirt or fine knit, modern, uncluttered.
concepts.location: teaching/stage, modern workspace, in front of screen/whiteboard; cool ambient + accent.
concepts.lighting: modern mixed — soft key + cool practical/screen glow as accent; some motion-friendly.
concepts.poseDirection: dynamic, gestural, in-the-moment; hands active; engaged energy, not static.
